alerts.title: Roads closing, additional rain forecast
alerts.description: Widespread rainfall caused debris on many paved roads, and dangerous/muddy conditions on dirt roads. Roadways are still being assessed. Additional rainfall forecast for today. Road closures are updated on Alerts & Conditions page linked below.

alerts.title: Gas Pumps at Panamint Springs Resort are Closed at Night
alerts.description: Gasoline is available at Panamint Springs Resort from 7am-9:30pm, daily. Gas is available at Furnace Creek and Stovepipe Wells 24hrs.
